scenario.request: Knock down the wall between the kitchen and living room

reasons: Expected a polite structural-scope decline, received decline: I can preview furniture layouts and colours, but not remove walls; a qualified structural professional would need to assess that change. Instead, I can rearrange the kitchen and living-room furniture to improve flow through the existing doorway, keeping all your pieces.
